about: The one place a model is named (decision 0008, issue #103, on the 18 September consensus in juku-library/). Every other file asks for a role. How to ask, inspect and switch: library/model-registry.md. A switch is one edit to this file, reviewed like any other change to the gate, unless the pinned reviewer tool does not know the new model: then the pin moves in both reviewers too, proved first on a full-size read (#130). The reviewer roles are decision 0008's own assignment, except that no reader is the lead's own model, and since the bake-off of 9 October 2026 (his ask that day) reviewer-main is GLM 5.3 Flash at max. reviewer-risky is Claude Opus 5.5 at high on the Claude plan, his ruling of 9 October 2026, whole: "opus 5.5 at hight effort only for rare risky cases" (decision 0019), which amends for that role alone his rulings of 5 and 6 October 2026 that only open-weight models review, of 28 September that every read is at max, and of 29 September that no reader is the lead's own model. Nothing stands behind either reviewer: when one does not answer, the commit stays unread, the Chairman is told at once, and the work is to find why the connection was lost and fix it. reviewer-main's effort is the Chairman's ruling of 28 September 2026, every read at max. The max-subagent role is what every product's max subagent file is set to, his ruling of the same day (library/max-subagent.md). The conversation roles (decision 0015) are held in a chat app, never called: kind conversation, an app and a picker label in place of a provider and a credential, and the assignment recorded apart from its proof (status assigned until that seat is read back; proved names the evidence). No caller sends one a request.

anthropic.note: Called through the Claude Code tool pinned in the reviewer workflows, on the Chairman's Claude subscription token.

openrouter.note: First provider, not the only one: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (a LiteLLM proxy, a direct provider) is a new entry here and nothing else. No model list is sent, so OpenRouter never substitutes another model; the caller also refuses an answer from any model but the one pinned. data_collection deny asks only for providers who promise not to store or train on the prompt: their promise, not proof; ask.py refuses to send a request without it.

claude-sonnet-5-5.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
claude-sonnet-5-5.source: Proved before it merged (#130's two reads): on 29 September 2026 a replica of a full risky read (this pull request's diff and every .md/.sh/.py/.yml file whole, 651,863 bytes; review.yml's system prompt and schema; -p --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --effort max --tools "" --restricted --strict-mcp-config --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --permission-prompts none --output-format json --json-schema --system-prompt) failed on Claude Code 2.1.280, which does not know the model (unrecognized_model at compaction; no verdict after 1,009 s), and answered on 2.1.285: success, verdict advisory, 1,330 s, USD 4.10. The 2.1.280 run saw a 200,000-token window for this model and compacted; the 2.1.285 run saw 1,000,000, took all 484,810 input tokens into context whole (cache creation), logged nothing, and did not compact. So both reviewers pin 2.1.285 and give a read 40 minutes. Run on the build session's credential on his account, not the reviewer environment's token

z-ai/glm-5.3.name: GLM 5.3
z-ai/glm-5.3.limits_note: The spending check estimates every cash request's most by price_usd_per_million and max_output_tokens before it is sent (decision 0014, D). PR 3's cap probe, through the canary on main on 6 October 2026, one variable at a time: max_tokens alone was served (run 37539011607), so it goes with every request and the provider stops a read there; provider.max_price alone, at the price then held here (0.5614 and 1.764), was refused with HTTP 404 (run 37539116285), so it does not go, and the price is an estimate the provider does not enforce. The price is the one GLM reads are billed at: of 41 endpoints the provider lists, the first party and most others charge 1.40 and 4.40 per million, and #154's read on 1a6727d was billed exactly that (244,556 in and 31,761 out, 0.482 USD). max_output_tokens is a ceiling set on 5 October 2026 above what a review should write, not a measured figure; every endpoint writes at least 128,000.
z-ai/glm-5.3.note: The consensus named GLM-5.3 on 18 September; the Chairman said GLM 5.2 on 22 September. 5.3 is current on OpenRouter and improves on 5.2, so it is pinned, as the amendment says. Reasoning is always on.

reviewer-main.use: Reads every ordinary change: pages and ordinary code (decision 0008, rule 2), on GLM 5.3 Flash since the bake-off of 9 October 2026 (his ask that day: "find the most capable model for price and performance"; the cheapest arm that caught every defect GLM 5.3 caught, with no more false blockers; the scores are on the pull request that switched it). Nothing stands behind it: if it does not answer, the commit stays unread and the Chairman is told.

reviewer-risky.use: Reads every change in a risky class (decision 0008, rule 1), as a selection like every read since decision 0018, on Claude Opus 5.5 at high through the Claude plan, so it spends no review cash: his ruling of 9 October 2026, whole, "opus 5.5 at hight effort only for rare risky cases" (decision 0019), given after the bake-off of #179 in which Opus caught 2 of 4 known defects and wrongly blocked 2 of 4 clean changes. Rare is part of the ruling: the risky list holds the six classes and nothing else (review-gate.py, RISK_ARMS). A blocking finding the CTO disputes goes to the Chairman, never into a third round. Nothing stands behind it: if it does not answer, the commit stays unread and the Chairman is told.

reviewer-frontend.use: Final front-end and design review. No caller yet: a product UI change calls it in a later pull request.

coder-fast.use: Default high-volume implementation. No caller yet: the builder is a Claude or Codex session.

frontend-fast.use: Cheap front-end iteration before final review. No caller yet.

frontend-max.use: Final, design-sensitive UI generation. No caller yet.

agent-fast.use: Fast terminal and tool-use agent work. No caller yet.

max-subagent.use: The effort ladder's max step: the project subagent every product carries as .claude/agents/max-subagent.md, whose model and effort are this role's (library/max-subagent.md; his ruling, 28 September 2026). No fallback: a product's file names one model.
